content:
I have replaced the old **Bespoke Fitting & Digital Tailoring** section on the homepage with a highly visual, dynamic **Limited Edition Drops & Launch Calendar** section!

### What Was Done
1. **Countdown Timer Engine**: Added a custom `CountdownTimer` component in [src/app/page.js](file:///E:/APP%203D/3d-apparel-studio/src/app/page.js) that handles live, ticking countdowns (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds) in real-time.
2. **Calendar UI**: Replaced the three old consult/booking cards with a streetwear drop calendar grid:
   - **Drop #04: Aero-Cyber Athletic Jersey** (Vibrant cyber design, live 2-day countdown, action: **"Set Launch Alert"**).
   - **Drop #05: Minimalist French Terry Hoodie** (Heavy French Terry details, live 8-day countdown, action: **"Set Launch Alert"**).
   - **Drop #03: Genesis Classic Boxy Tee** (Greyed out/Sold out drop highlighting past signature collections, action: **"Browse Catalog"**).
3. **Asset Generation**: Used our design generator to create futuristic cyberpunk jersey artwork (`/cyberpunk_jersey_drop.png`) and fleece streetwear hoodie assets (`/fleece_hoodie_drop.png`), which were saved and configured inside the `/public` directory.
4. **Successful Build**: Verified that the entire project builds successfully (`npm run build`) with no JSX syntax issues or Turbopack compile blocks.

Please refer to the updated [walkthrough.md](file:///C:/Users/Balamurugan/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/14342646-882e-4d6c-83a2-5752e47c2cbe/walkthrough.md) artifact for details on the implementation.
